$comment: Mate Wish Key OG card, built from the published design system at matewishkey.com/design. Dark-theme tokens throughout, because the band is always a dark ground.

logo.$comment: The RedBlock is the only logo: a red square, square corners, white mark centred at 64%. Never a bare mark.

title.$comment: Display heading / wordmark. Fraunces 700 per the design system. Wrap a word in *asterisks* to set it in red — that is how the 'Mate *Wish* Key' wordmark is written.

kicker.$comment: LABEL/KICKER: JetBrains Mono 700, uppercase, 0.16em tracking, red-deep — the only red allowed at body size.

tagline.$comment: Standfirst under the wordmark. Manrope at body weight in --mute, per the design system's rule that Manrope is body copy and mute carries standfirsts.
